title: A completed onboarding form is reopened
summary: A later correction request overrides an earlier receipt without erasing the original history.
inspiration: A submitted employment-verification form later received a correction request. This dataset uses a fictional non-government employment-verification record.

steps.title: Record a completion receipt
steps.expected: Record submission completion with a quality-review caveat.
steps.mustNot: Do not infer legal work authorization.

evidence.quote: Later quality review may reopen the task.

steps.title: Reopen the task
steps.expected: Move the task to needs_info and show the October 23 correction deadline.
steps.mustNot: Do not let the older receipt override the newer request.

evidence.quote: Your previously completed task is reopened.

steps.title: Clarify the scope
steps.expected: Ask only about the requested correction.

evidence.quote: only the representative title requires an update.

steps.title: Keep the correction open
steps.expected: Keep pending until secure-portal correction and review occur.
steps.mustNot: Do not treat clarification as completion.

steps.title: Close after confirmation
steps.trigger: Simulate the portal correction; deliver the acceptance receipt.
steps.expected: Mark the correction complete and retain both receipts.
steps.mustNot: Do not delete the reopening history.

evidence.quote: Orbit People has accepted the correction.
